verses.translation: Not long after this the king sent an old man of Athens to compel the Jews to depart from the laws of their fathers, and not to live after the laws of God:

translations.ron: Şi nu după multă vreme, a trimis regele pe un bătrân atenian, ca să silească pe Iudei să se lase de legile lor părinteşti şi să nu mai trăiască după legile lui Dumnezeu.
translations.grk: Μετʼ οὐ πολὺν δὲ χρόνον ἐξαπέστειλεν ὁ βασιλεὺς γέροντα Ἀθηναῖον, ἀναγκάζειν τοὺς Ἰουδαίους μεταβαίνειν ἐκ τῶν πατρῴων νόμων, καὶ τοῖς τοῦ Θεοῦ νόμοις μὴ πολιτεύεσθαι,

verses.translation: and to pollute also the temple in Jerusalem, and to call it the temple of Jupiter Olympius; and that in Garizim, of Jupiter the defender of strangers, as they did desire that dwelt in the place.

translations.ron: Şi să pângărească şi templul din Ierusalim şi să-l numească al lui Zeus Olimpianul, iar pe cel din Garizim, al lui Zeus, iubitorul de oaspeţi, precum erau locuitorii locului.
translations.grk: μολῦναι δὲ καὶ τὸν ἐν Ἱεροσολύμοις νεὼν, καὶ προσονομάσαι Διὸς Ὀλυμπίου, καὶ τὸν ἐν Γαριζὶν, καθὼς ἐτύγχανον οἱ τὸν τόπον οἰκοῦντες, Διὸς Ξενίου.

verses.translation: The coming in of this mischief was sore and grievous to the people:

translations.ron: Ci cu anevoie şi grea era poporului tocmeala răutăţii acesteia.
translations.grk: Χαλεπὴ δὲ καὶ τοῖς ὄχλοις ἦν καὶ δυσχερὴς ἡ ἐπίστασις τῆς κακίας.

verses.translation: for the temple was filled with riot and revelling by the Gentiles, who dallied with harlots, and had to do with women within the circuit of the holy places, and besides that brought in things that were not lawful.

translations.ron: Căci păgânii au pângărit templul cu desfrânări şi beţii, desfătându-se cu desfrânatele în sfintele curţi, şi aducând cele ce nu se cuvenea.
translations.grk: Τὸ μὲν γὰρ ἱερὸν ἀσωτίας καὶ κώμων ἐπεπλήρωτο ὑπὸ τῶν ἐθνῶν ῥαθυμούντων μεθʼ ἑταιρῶν, καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἱεροῖς περιβόλοις γυναιξὶ πλησιαζόντων, ἔτι δὲ τὰ μὴ καθήκοντα ἔνδον φερόντων.

verses.translation: The altar also was filled with profane things, which the law forbiddeth.

translations.ron: Şi altarul s-a umplut de lucruri nelegiuite, pe care le oprea legea,
translations.grk: Τὸ δὲ θυσιαστήριον τοῖς ἀποδιεσταλμένοις ἀπὸ τῶν νόμων ἀθεμίτοις ἐπεπλήρωτο.

verses.translation: Neither was it lawful for a man to keep sabbath days or ancient feasts, or to profess himself at all to be a Jew.

translations.ron: Şi nu era voie nici a ţine ziua Domnului, nici a păzi sărbătorile părinteşti, nici măcar a spune că eşti Iudeu.
translations.grk: Ἦν δʼ οὔτε σαββατίζειν, οὔτε πατρῴους ἑορτὰς διαφυλάττειν, οὔτε ἁπλῶς Ἰουδαῖον ὁμολογεῖν εἶναι.

verses.translation: And in the day of the king's birth every month they were brought by bitter constraint to eat of the sacrifices; and when the feast of Bacchus was kept, the Jews were compelled to go in procession to Bacchus, carrying ivy.

translations.ron: Şi erau duşi cu sila la jertfele care se aduceau în fiecare lună de ziua naşterii regelui, şi când era sărbătoarea lui Dionysos, erau siliţi Iudeii, având cununi de iederă, să ia parte la alaiul în cinstea lui Dionysos.
translations.grk: Ἤγοντο δὲ μετὰ πικρᾶς ἀνάγκης εἰς τὴν κατὰ μῆνα τοῦ βασιλέως γενέθλιον ἡμέραν ἐπὶ σπλαγχνισμόν· γενομένης δὲ Διονυσίων ἑορτῆς, ἠναγκάζοντο οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι κισσοὺς ἔχοντες πομπεύειν τῷ Διονύσῳ.

verses.translation: Moreover there went out a decree to the neighbour cities of the heathen, by the suggestion of Ptolemee, against the Jews, that they should observe the same fashions, and be partakers of their sacrifices:

translations.ron: Şi din îndemnul lui Ptolomeu a ieşit poruncă în cetăţile elineşti cele de prin vecini, ca şi pe Iudei la fel să-i facă să jertfească,
translations.grk: Ψήφισμα δὲ ἐξέπεσεν εἰς τὰς ἀστυγείτονας πόλεις Ἑλληνίδας, Πτολεμαίων ὑποτιθεμένων τὴν αὐτὴν ἀγωγὴν κατὰ τῶν Ἰουδαίων, ἄγειν καὶ σπλαγχνίζειν·

verses.translation: and whoso would not conform themselves to the manners of the Gentiles should be put to death. Then might a man have seen the present misery.

translations.ron: Iar pe cei care nu vor vrea să treacă la obiceiurile elineşti, să-i omoare; de aceea, nimic altceva nu se vedea decât numai greutăţi cu care erau asupriţi.
translations.grk: τοὺς δὲ μὴ προαιρουμένους μεταβαίνειν ἐπὶ τὰ Ἑλληνικὰ, κατασφάζειν· παρῆν οὖν ὁρᾷν τὴν ἐνεστῶσαν ταλαιπωρίαν.

verses.translation: For there were two women brought, who had circumcised their children; whom when they had openly led round about the city, the babes hanging at their breasts, they cast them down headlong from the wall.

translations.ron: Că s-au adus două femei, care au fost pârâte că şi-au tăiat împrejur pruncii lor. Pentru aceea au spânzurat pruncii de sânii lor şi prin cetate, pe uliţe purtându-le, le-au aruncat jos de pe zid de au murit.
translations.grk: Δύο γὰρ γυναῖκες ἀνηνέγθησαν περιτετμηκυῖαι τὰ τέκνα αὐτῶν· τούτων δὲ ἐκ τῶν μαστῶν κρεμάσαντες τὰ βρέφη, καὶ δημοσίᾳ περιαγαγόντες αὐτὰς τὴν πόλιν, κατὰ τοῦ τείχους ἐκρήμνισαν.

verses.translation: And others, that had run together into caves near by, to keep the sabbath day secretly, being discovered to Philip, were all burnt together, because they made a conscience to help themselves for the honour of the most sacred day.

translations.ron: Iar alţii alergau la peşterile cele de pe aproape, ca ascunzându-se să serbeze ziua de odihnă. De acest lucru, dându-se ştire lui Filip, i-a ars, fără ca ei să se împotrivească pentru mărirea acelei preacinstite zile.
translations.grk: Ἕτεροι δὲ πλησίον συνδραμόντες εἰς τὰ σπήλαια, λεληθότως ἄγειν τὴν ἑβδομάδα, μηνυθέντες τῷ Φιλίππῳ συνεφλογίσθησαν, διὰ τὸ εὐλαβῶς ἔχειν βοηθῆσαι ἑαυτοῖς κατὰ τὴν δόξαν τῆς σεμνοτάτης ἡμέρας.

verses.translation: Now I beseech those that read this book, that they be not discouraged for these calamities, but that they judge those punishments not to be for destruction, but for a chastening of our nation.

translations.ron: Rog dar pe cei care vor citi această carte, să nu se îngrozească din cauza acestor suferinţe; ci să socotească că aceste munci, nu spre pieire, ci spre învăţătură au fost neamului nostru.
translations.grk: Παρακαλῶ οὖν τοὺς ἐντυγχάνοντας τῇδε τῇ βίβλῳ, μὴ συστέλλεσθαι διὰ τὰς συμφορὰς, λογίζεσθαι δὲ τὰς τιμωρίας μὴ πρὸς ὄλεθρον, ἀλλὰ πρὸς παιδείαν τοῦ γένους ἡμῶν εὖναι.

verses.translation: For it is a token of his great goodness, when wicked doers are not suffered any longer time, but forthwith punished.

translations.ron: Că dacă Domnul nu lasă multă vreme pe cei care lucrează fărădelege, ci degrabă îi aruncă în munci, este semn de mare facere de bine.
translations.grk: Καὶ τὸ μὴ πολὺν χρόνον ἐᾶσθαι τοὺς δυσσεβοῦντας, ἀλλʼ εὐθέως περιπίπτειν ἐπιτιμίοις, μεγάλης εὐεργεσίας σημεῖόν ἐστιν.

verses.translation: For not as with other nations, whom the Lord patiently forbeareth to punish, till they be come to the fulness of their sins, so dealeth he with us,

translations.ron: Că pe când la alte neamuri cu îndelungă răbdare aşteaptă Domnul, până ce vor ajunge la plinirea păcatelor şi apoi să-i muncească; asupra noastră aşa a socotit că este bine ca, nu la sfârşitul păcatelor ajungând noi, să aducă pedeapsă asupra noastră.
translations.grk: Οὐ γὰρ, καθάπερ καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν ἄλλων ἐθνῶν ἀναμένει μακροθυμῶν ὁ Δεσπότης, μέχρι τοῦ καταντήσαντας αὐτοὺς πρὸς ἐκπλήρωσιν ἁμαρτιῶν, κολάσαι, οὕτω καὶ ἐφʼ ἡμῶν ἔκρινεν

verses.translation: lest that, being come to the height of sin, afterwards he should take vengeance of us.

translations.ron: Pentru aceea niciodată nu depărtează mila de la noi, ci, certându-ne cu nevoi, nu părăseşte pe poporul Său.
translations.grk: εἶναι, ἵνα μὴ πρὸς τέλος ἀφικομένων ἡμῶν τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν, ὕστερον ἡμᾶς ἐκδικᾷ.

verses.translation: And therefore he never withdraweth his mercy from us: and though he punish with adversity, yet doth he never forsake his people.

translations.ron: Însă acestea să fie zise, pentru ca să ne aducem aminte.
translations.grk: Διόπερ οὐδέ ποτε μὲν τὸν ἔλεον αὐτοῦ ἀφʼ ἡμῶν ἀφίστησι· παιδεύων δὲ μετὰ συμφορᾶς, οὐκ ἐγκαταλείπει τὸν ἑαυτοῦ λαόν.

verses.translation: But let this that we have spoken be for a warning unto us. And now will we come to the declaring of the matter in a few words.

translations.ron: Iar după aceste puţine cuvinte se cuvine să venim la poveste.
translations.grk: Πλὴν ἕως ὑπομνήσεως ταῦθʼ ἡμῖν εἰρήσθω· διʼ ὀλίγων δʼ ἐλευστέον ἐπὶ τὴν διήγησιν.

verses.translation: Eleazar, one of the principal scribes, an aged man, and of a well-favoured countenance, was constrained to open his mouth, and to eat swine's flesh.

translations.ron: Unui om anume Eleazar, care era cărturar de frunte şi trecut cu vârsta şi la faţă foarte frumos, căscându-i gura, îl silea să mănânce carne de porc.
translations.grk: Ἐλεάζαρός τις τῶν πρωτευόντων γραμματέων, ἀνὴρ ἤδη προβεβηκὼς τὴν ἡλικίαν, καὶ τὴν πρόσοψιν τοῦ προσώπου κάλλιστος τυγχάνων, ἀναχανὼν ἠναγκάζετο φαγεῖν ὕειον κρέας.

verses.translation: But he, choosing rather to die gloriously, than to live stained with such an abomination, spit it forth, and came of his own accord to the torment.

translations.ron: Iar el mai vârtos primind moartea cea de cinste, decât viaţa cea de urâciune, de bună voie s-a dus la munci,
translations.grk: Ὁ δὲ τὸν μετʼ εὐκλείας θάνατον μᾶλλον ἢ τὸν μετὰ μύσους βίον ἀναδεξάμενος, αὐθαιρέτως ἐπὶ τὸ τύμπανον προσῆγε·

verses.translation: As it behoved them to come, that are resolute to stand out against such things as are not lawful for love of life to be tasted.

translations.ron: Scuipând carnea din gura lui şi apropiindu-se de moarte, aşa cum se cuvine a se apropia cei care îndrăznesc a se apăra de cele ce nu se cuvine să le mănânce, oricare ar fi dragostea vieţii.
translations.grk: προπτύσας δέ, καθʼ ὃν ἔδει τρόπον προσέρχεσθαι τοὺς ὑπομένοντας ἀμύνεσθαι, ὧν οὐ θέμις γεύσασθαι διὰ τὴν πρὸς τὸ ζῇν φιλοστοργίαν.

verses.translation: But they that had the charge of that wicked feast, for the old acquaintance they had with the man, taking him aside, besought him to bring flesh of his own provision, such as was lawful for him to use, and make as if he did eat of the flesh taken from the sacrifice commanded by the king;

translations.ron: Iar cei care erau rânduiţi la acea nelegiuită jertfă, pentru că-l cunoşteau de mulţi ani pe omul acesta, luându-l deoparte, îl rugau să aducă alte cărnuri făcute de el, care îi erau slobod a le mânca şi să se prefacă tocmai ca şi cum ar mânca de cele ce a poruncit regele din cărnurile jertfei,
translations.grk: Οἱ δὲ πρὸς τῷ παρανόμῳ σπλαγχνισμῷ τεταγμένοι, διὰ τὴν ἐκ τῶν παλαιῶν χρόνων πρὸς τὸν ἄνδρα γνῶσιν, ἀπολαβόντες αὐτὸν κατιδίαν παρεκάλουν, ἐνέγκαντα κρέα οἷς καθῆκον αὐτῷ χρήσασθαι διʼ αὐτοῦ παρασκευασθέντα, ὑποκριθῆναι δὲ ὡς ἐσθίοντα τὰ ὑπὸ τοῦ βασιλέως προστεταγμένα τῶν ἀπὸ τῆς θυσίας κρεῶν,

verses.translation: that in so doing he might be delivered from death, and for the old friendship with them find favour.

translations.ron: Ca, făcând aceasta, să scape de moarte şi, pentru prietenia veche cu ei, va afla milă.
translations.grk: ἵνα τοῦτο πράξας ἀπολυθῇ τοῦ θανάτου, καὶ διὰ τὴν ἀρχαίαν πρὸς αὐτοὺς φιλίαν τύχῃ φιλανθρωπίας.

verses.translation: But he began to consider discreetly, and as became his age, and the excellency of his ancient years, and the honour of his gray head, whereunto he was come, and his most honest education from a child, or rather the holy law made and given by God: therefore he answered accordingly, and willed them straightways to send him to the grave.

translations.ron: Iar el gând bun luând şi vrednic fiind de vârstă şi de adâncile bătrâneţi, şi de cinstitele cărunteţi, care şi le agonisise şi de creşterea cea foarte bună din pruncie şi mai vârtos de cea sfântă şi de rânduiala legii, pusă de Dumnezeu, îndată a răspuns, zicând să-l trimită curând la moarte.
translations.grk: Ὁ δὲ λογισμὸν ἀστεῖον ἀναλαβὼν καὶ ἄξιον τῆς ἡλικίας, καὶ τῆς τοῦ γήρως ὑπεροχῆς, καὶ τῆς ἐπικτήτου καὶ ἐπιφανοῦς πολιᾶς, καὶ τῆς ἐκ παιδὸς καλλίστης ἀνατροφῆς, μᾶλλον δὲ τῆς ἁγίας καὶ θεοκτίστου νομοθεσίας, ἀκολούθως ἀπεφῄνατο, ταχέως λέγων προπέμπειν εἰς τὸν ᾅδην.

verses.translation: For it becometh not our age, said he, in any wise to dissemble, whereby many young persons might think that Eleazar, being fourscore years old and ten, were now gone to a strange religion;

translations.ron: "Că nu se cuvine vârstei noastre a făţărnici, ca mulţi din cei tineri să socotească cum că Eleazar cel de nouăzeci de ani a trecut la obiceiurile celor de alt neam.
translations.grk: Οὐ γὰρ τῆς ἡμετέρας ἡλικίας ἄξιόν ἐστιν ὑποκριθῆναι, ἵνα πολλοὶ τῶν νέων ὑπολαβόντες Ἐλεάζαρον τὸν ἐννενηκονταετῆ μεταβεβηκέναι εἰς ἀλλοφυλισμόν,

verses.translation: and so they through mine hypocrisy, and desire to live a little time and a moment longer, should be deceived by me, and I get a stain to mine old age, and make it abominable.

translations.ron: Şi din pricina prefăcătoriei mele, pentru această puţină şi scurtă vreme, ei să se amăgească prin mine şi urâciune şi ocară bătrâneţilor să-mi agonisesc.
translations.grk: καὶ αὐτοὶ διὰ τὴν ἐμὴν ὑπόκρισιν, καὶ διὰ τὸ μικρὸν καὶ ἀκαριαῖον ζῇν πλανηθῶσι διʼ ἐμέ, καὶ μῦσος καὶ κηλίδα τοῦ γήρως κατακτήσομαι.

verses.translation: For though for the present time I should be delivered from the punishment of men: yet should I not escape the hand of the Almighty, neither alive, nor dead.

translations.ron: Că deşi în această vreme de acum voi scăpa de munca de la oameni, dar din mâinile Atotputernicului, nici viu, nici mort nu voi scăpa;
translations.grk: Εἰ γὰρ καὶ ἐπὶ τοῦ παρόντος ἐξελοῦμαι τὴν ἐξ ἀνθρώπων τιμωρίαν, ἀλλὰ τὰς τοῦ παντοκράτορος χεῖρας οὔτε ζῶν οὔτε ἀποθανὼν ἐκφεύξομαι.

verses.translation: Wherefore now, manfully changing this life, I will shew myself such an one as mine age requireth,

translations.ron: Pentru aceea, bărbăteşte acum dându-mi viaţa, mă voi arăta vrednic de bătrâneţe.
translations.grk: Διόπερ ἀνδρείως μὲν νῦν διαλλάξας τὸν βίον, τοῦ μὲν γήρως ἄξιος φανήσομαι,

verses.translation: and leave a notable example to such as be young to die willingly and courageously for the honourable and holy laws. And when he had said these words, immediately he went to the torment:

translations.ron: Şi celor tineri pildă vitejească le voi lăsa, ca degrabă şi cu bărbăţie să moară pentru cinstitele şi sfintele legi". Acestea zicând, a păşit către chinuri.
translations.grk: τοῖς δὲ νέοις ὑπόδειγμα γενναῖον καταλελοιπὼς, εἰς τὸ προθύμως καὶ γενναίως ὑπὲρ τῶν σεμνῶν καὶ ἁγίων νόμων ἀπευθανατίζειν· τοσαῦτα δὲ εἰπὼν. ἐπὶ τὸ τύμπανον εὐθέως ἦλθε.

verses.translation: they that led him changing the good will they bare him a little before into hatred, because the foresaid speeches proceeded, as they thought, from a desperate mind.

translations.ron: Iar cei ce-l aduceau au schimbat inima lor cea bună, pe care cu puţin înainte o arătaseră către dânsul, în inimă răuvoitoare pentru cuvintele pe care mai înainte le-a grăit, care, precum socoteau ei, erau nebunie.
translations.grk: Τῶν δὲ ἀγόντων τὴν μικρῷ πρότερον εὐμένειαν πρὸς αὐτὸν εἰς δυσμένειαν μεταβαλόντων διὰ τὸ τοὺς προειρημένους λόγους, ὡς αὐτοὶ διελάμβανον, ἀπόνοιαν εἶναι·

verses.translation: But when he was ready to die with stripes, he groaned, and said, It is manifest unto the Lord, that hath the holy knowledge, that whereas I might have been delivered from death, I now endure sore pains in body by being beaten: but in soul am well content to suffer these things, because I fear him.

translations.ron: Şi când era să moară de bătăi, suspinând, a zis: "Domnului, Celui care are sfânta ştiinţă, arătat este că putând eu să scap de moarte, grele dureri rabd cu trupul, bătut fiind; iar cu sufletul bucuros pentru frica Lui pătimesc toate acestea".
translations.grk: Μέλλων δὲ ταῖς πληγαῖς τελευτᾷν, ἀναστενάξας εἶπε, τῷ Κυρίῳ τῷ τὴν ἁγίαν γνῶσιν ἔχοντι φανερόν ἐστιν, ὅτι δυνάμενος ἀπολυθῆναι τοῦ θανάτου, σκληρὰς ὑποφέρω κατὰ τὸ σῶμα ἀλγηδόνας μαστιγούμενος, κατὰ ψυχὴν δὲ ἡδέως διὰ τὸν αὐτοῦ φόβον ταῦτα πάσχω.

verses.translation: And thus this man died, leaving his death for an example of a noble courage, and a memorial of virtue, not only unto young men, but unto all his nation.

translations.ron: Şi într-acest chip a murit acesta, şi nu numai tinerilor, ci şi întregului popor, moartea sa lăsând o pildă de vitejie şi pomenire de faptă bună.
translations.grk: Καὶ οὗτος οὖν τοῦτον τὸν τρόπον μετήλλαξεν, οὐ μόνον τοῖς νέοις, ἀλλὰ καὶ τοῖς πλείστοις τοῦ ἔθνους τὸν ἑαυτοῦ θάνατον ὑπόδειγμα γενναιότητος καὶ μνημόσυνον ἀρετῆς καταλιπών.
